mutations.name: a run in sh-cleanup reads as watching main CI again
kills: a run parked in recovery after it recorded its outcome says a running run past its main CI read is cleaning up, not watching main CI

mutations.name: every post-merge step reads as cleaning up
kills: a run parked in recovery after it recorded its outcome still says a run in sh-main-ci is watching main CI

kills: a run parked in recovery after it recorded its outcome says none for a completed merged run whose last step was sh-cleanup
